preconditions.description: The number of words N must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 1000 for l in lengths)
preconditions.description: Each word length must be a natural number not exceeding 1000.
The number of lengths provided must match the number of words N.

postconditions.description: Output 'NO' if it's impossible to reconstruct the words, otherwise output 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(words[i]) == lengths[i] for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each output word must have the length specified in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(words[i].startswith(words[j]) for j in range(N) if i != j) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: No word can be a prefix of another word.
